info.title: Get Aftersale Eligibility
info.description: Use this API to check eligible aftersale solutions for an order, including whether the seller or buyer can initiate a refund, return, or cancel a specific order.

get.description: Use this API to check eligible aftersale solutions for an order, including whether the seller or buyer can initiate a refund, return, or cancel a specific order.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: initiate_aftersale_user
parameters.description:
The type of user you would like to check aftersale options for.
Default: SELLER
Possible values:
- SELLER
- BUYER

parameters.name: request_types
parameters.description:
**Optional.** Specifies which request types to query. If omitted, the API returns all request types currently available for the specified initiator. Possible values:
-`CANCEL`
-`REFUND`
-`RETURN_AND_REFUND`

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

order_line_items_ids.description: Specifies the order line IDs. **Note:** This is a legacy field for new integrations use `order_line_list` instead.

eligible.description:
Use this field to recognize whether an item is eligible for an aftersale request:
- `TRUE`
- `FALSE`

ineligible_code.description: The reason code for an ineligible aftersale request.

ineligible_reason.description: The reason for an ineligible aftersale request.

available_reason_names.description: A list of reason names that can be used when creating a follow-up aftersale request.

sub_order_line_item_id.description:
The sub-order-line ID inside a bundle product
- Required for bundle products
- Not required for non-bundle products

order_line_list.description: Specifies the order line items. **Note:** This field is completely backward compatible with the previous `order_line_items_ids` field.

line_item_eligibility.description: The eligible aftersale options based on order line item.

sku_eligibility.description: The eligible aftersale options for a given SKU.
